meaning.vi: Hình thức nuôi dưỡng số nhiều.

sentences.en: These sources of minerals develop in a sequence that takes millions of years, beginning with rock formation, the breakdown of rocks into mineral salts, and the assimilation of these salts into soil that nourishes edible plants.
